=== Proof Status ===

1 [[32mvalidated[0m/[32mclean[0m] Mass split: for an exact signed idempotent P and any row index v, writing a_j = P_{vj}, a_j^+ = max(a_j, 0), a_j^- = max(-a_j, 0), and nu_v = sum_j a_j^-, one has sum_j a_j^+ = 1 + nu_v.
  1.1 [[32mvalidated[0m/[32mclean[0m] Since P is an exact signed idempotent, P\mathbf 1=\mathbf 1; hence for row v, \sum_j a_j=\sum_j P_{vj}=1.
  1.2 [[32mvalidated[0m/[32mclean[0m] For every j, a_j=a_j^+-a_j^-.
  1.3 [[32mvalidated[0m/[32mclean[0m] Summing the pointwise identity gives \sum_j a_j=\sum_j a_j^+-\sum_j a_j^-.
  1.4 [[32mvalidated[0m/[32mclean[0m] Using \nu_v=\sum_j a_j^- and \sum_j a_j=1, one obtains \sum_j a_j^+=1+\nu_v.
